title: Who approves which projects
question: Which projects does Track3D review (implementation or customer success), and which do enterprise super-admins or regional admins approve through the order-form and signing flow? Which projects are auto-approved?
context: The confirmed rule is Track3D review for normal projects (PROJ-REQ-007). The historical PRD describes enterprise admin approval with DocuSign signing (PROJ-REQ-011, PROJ-REQ-012), the user confirmed that those enterprise features exist (USER-REQ-041), and code auto-approves some cases (PROJ-REQ-004).
